name: get_pricing
description: Get detailed AWS pricing from the AWS Price List API for a service, with optional region and filters. Use this to compute monthly cost deltas when changing the architecture (e.g. RDS vs Aurora). Returns on-demand/flat-rate price points; pricing is current (not historical).

region.description: AWS region whose prices to fetch, e.g. 'us-east-1' or 'ap-south-1'. Omit for global services like CloudFront or DataTransfer.

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow results. Discover valid Field/Value pairs before guessing.

Value.description: One or more values to match. Use a single-element array for EQUALS.

max_allowed_characters.description: Response size cap in characters (default 100000, use -1 for unlimited).
